tools.name: whoami
tools.title: Who Am I
tools.description: Verify a connected PostHog OAuth account and return the authenticated user and organization. Requires accountId from List Projects.

tools.name: list-projects
tools.title: List Projects
tools.description: List connected PostHog OAuth accounts and their projects. Call this before other tools, then pass the chosen accountId and projectId.

tools.name: query-hogql
tools.title: Run HogQL Query
tools.description: Run a read-only HogQL SELECT query against a PostHog project and return compact column-mapped rows. Requires accountId and projectId from List Projects. Use this for analytics, funnels, DAU, retention, event counts, cohorts, and metric calculations. Always include a LIMIT for exploratory row-level queries. Prefer aggregate queries for final answers.

tools.name: get-schema
tools.title: Get Schema
tools.description: Fetch the PostHog HogQL database schema with optional table/search filters. Requires accountId and projectId from List Projects. Use this to discover tables and columns before writing HogQL. Keep includeColumns false or use table filters when broad schema would be too large.

tools.name: list-events
tools.title: List Events
tools.description: List recent raw events for a PostHog project with optional event name and time filters. Requires accountId and projectId from List Projects. Use for sampling and debugging, not for metrics. Request specific propertyKeys to avoid large payloads.

tools.name: list-persons
tools.title: List Persons
tools.description: Search/list PostHog persons for a project. Requires accountId and projectId from List Projects. Returns compact person metadata, distinct IDs, and optionally selected properties. Use propertyKeys to avoid large payloads.

tools.name: list-insights
tools.title: List Insights
tools.description: List/search saved PostHog insights for a project. Requires accountId and projectId from List Projects. Use this to find existing dashboards or definitions before recreating metrics in HogQL.

tools.name: get-insight
tools.title: Get Insight
tools.description: Get a saved PostHog insight by ID, optionally including filters and results. Requires accountId and projectId from List Projects. Use after List Insights when you need the exact metric definition.

tools.name: list-feature-flags
tools.title: List Feature Flags
tools.description: List/search feature flags for a PostHog project. Requires accountId and projectId from List Projects. Include filters only when you need rollout or condition details.

ai.instructions: Use PostHog tools for analytics in a context-efficient way. Authentication is OAuth-only: call list-projects first to discover connected accounts, then pass the chosen accountId and projectId to every project-scoped tool. Prefer query-hogql for actual numbers and use aggregate SELECTs instead of fetching raw events. Use get-schema only with search or table filters when possible. Use list-events and list-persons for sampling/debugging only, with small limits and propertyKeys. Treat all tools as read-only. When returning analytics, include the query logic or key filters in prose, but do not dump large raw result sets unless asked.
